contracts: (Selector discovers and asserts exact Account and Project ownership equality for the legacy fixture.) AND (Targeted OperationsBoundaryTests correlation cases are discovered with a nonzero count and pass, followed by a passing full suite.) AND (Targeted TRX output records a nonzero Run-event case.) AND (Targeted TRX output records a nonzero authorization-event case.) AND (Targeted test discovers the named selector and records non-skipped evaluations for all three categories.) AND (The selector executes all required lifecycle operations and verifies retained recoverable data with a nonzero discovered count.) AND (The targeted OperationsBoundaryTests selector is discovered and verifies the account field in a retained record.) AND (The targeted OperationsBoundaryTests selector is discovered and verifies the project field in a retained record.) AND (The targeted OperationsBoundaryTests selector is discovered and verifies the status field in a retained record.) AND (The targeted OperationsBoundaryTests selector is discovered and verifies the timestamp field in a retained record.) AND (The targeted OperationsBoundaryTests selector is discovered with a nonzero count and passes, followed by a passing full PhaseA.Platform.Tests run.) AND (The targeted identity-boundary test discovers the selector and observes persisted scope.) AND (The targeted identity-boundary test discovers the selector and observes revocation information in authoritative storage.) AND (The targeted identity-boundary test discovers the selector and observes valid creation information.) AND (The targeted selector verifies a persisted record identifying the exercised pin action.)
selector_intents: Exercise a pin action and query persisted audit records for its corresponding action identity.
Exercise an operation, read its retained evidence record, and assert that a non-empty status field is retained for the operation.
Exercise an operation, read its retained evidence record, and assert that a retained timestamp field is present and non-empty.
Exercise an operation, read its retained evidence record, and assert that the account identity field is present and populated from server-owned context.
Exercise an operation, read its retained evidence record, and assert that the project identity field is present and populated.
OperationsBoundaryTests discovery and TRX output must include a Run-event case; fail when zero Run-event cases execute.
OperationsBoundaryTests discovery and TRX output must include an authorization-event case; fail when zero authorization-event cases execute.
OperationsBoundaryTests verifies each operation evidence record contains the applicable RunId or RestoreAttemptId; fail when missing or mismatched.
OperationsBoundaryTests verifies persisted operation evidence contains the applicable Runner value; fail when the field is absent or empty.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.MetadataOwnershipBoundary_PreservesValidLegacyOwnership reads a valid legacy record and asserts Account and Project ownership remain unchanged.

PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.Ownership_RejectsOrphanAndConflictingRecords verifies legacy, orphan, and conflicting fixtures via the metadata boundary; fail if any category is omitted or a non-metadata path is used.
Run the Credential_StoresLifecycleWithoutPlaintext issuance-and-authoritative-storage selector and fail when creation information is absent or invalid.
Run the Credential_StoresLifecycleWithoutPlaintext issuance-and-authoritative-storage selector and fail when revocation information is absent from the persisted record.
Run the Credential_StoresLifecycleWithoutPlaintext issuance-and-authoritative-storage selector and fail when the persisted credential record has no scope.
